cohort: Pregnant women who delivered at Hospital Tuanku Ja’afar Seremban, Malaysia, between May 2015 and May 2016, divided into teenage (n=164) and non-teenage (n=169) groups
finding: Teenage pregnancy was associated with a significantly higher risk of anemia, episiotomy, preterm labor, and delivering low-birthweight babies, but no significant differences were found in other outcomes.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was measured as an outcome
